key: DANIELLE: Greetings, Trainer who I have clearly never seen and has definitely not already blown the quiz once.
en: DANIELLE: Greetings, Trainer who I have clearly never seen and has definitely not already blown the quiz once.
ja: ダニエール: こんにちは、トレーナーさん。ええ、あなたのことなんて絶対に初めて見るし、このクイズに一度失敗したことなんて絶対にありませんよね。

key: Please allow me to regale you with mind-boggling questions--
en: Please allow me to regale you with mind-boggling questions--
ja: さあ、頭を悩ませる問題の数々でおもてなしさせてもらうわ――

key: Okay, you know what, let's just get to it before my dead eyes roll into the back of my head.
en: Okay, you know what, let's just get to it before my dead eyes roll into the back of my head.
ja: はいはい、もういいから始めましょ。じゃないと、この死んだ目が頭の中に転がっていっちゃいそう。

key: DANIELLE: What, you want to try the quiz again?
en: DANIELLE: What, you want to try the quiz again?
ja: ダニエール: 何? もう一回クイズに挑戦したいの?

key: You probably just went and specifically looked for the answer, didn't you? It's no fun at that point.
en: You probably just went and specifically looked for the answer, didn't you? It's no fun at that point.
ja: どうせ答えをわざわざ調べてきたんでしょ? そんなの、ちっとも面白くないじゃない。

key: Hmph. Fine, if it'll make you feel better, I'll pretend I'm stupid enough to go for that!
en: Hmph. Fine, if it'll make you feel better, I'll pretend I'm stupid enough to go for that!
ja: ふん。まあいいわ、それで気が済むなら、そんなことにも引っかかるくらいバカなふりをしてあげる!

key: Are you ready, first-timer?
en: Are you ready, first-timer?
ja: 準備はいい、初心者さん?

key: ???: Greetings from the blind.
en: ???: Greetings from the blind.
ja: ???: 盲目の者からのご挨拶よ。

key: The name's Danielle, but don't you dare pity me, Trainer.
en: The name's Danielle, but don't you dare pity me, Trainer.
ja: 名前はダニエール。でも同情なんてしないでよね、トレーナー。

key: I see more than you ever will.
en: I see more than you ever will.
ja: わたしはあなたよりずっと多くを見ているんだから。

key: But I'll humor you.
en: But I'll humor you.
ja: でも、付き合ってあげる。

key: I'll ask you three questions. If you can answer all of them, I'll give you a reward.
en: I'll ask you three questions. If you can answer all of them, I'll give you a reward.
ja: 三つ質問するわ。全部答えられたら、ご褒美をあげる。

key: Wanna try it?
en: Wanna try it?
ja: 挑戦する?

key: DANIELLE: Question number one-- this is an easy one.
en: DANIELLE: Question number one-- this is an easy one.
ja: ダニエール: 第一問――これは簡単よ。

key: How many headbutt trees are there in the area around the Grand Hall?
en: How many headbutt trees are there in the area around the Grand Hall?
ja: 大ホールの周りにある、頭突きできる木は何本?

key: DANIELLE: That's right. Simple enough, isn't it?
en: DANIELLE: That's right. Simple enough, isn't it?
ja: ダニエール: 正解。簡単すぎたかしら?

key: Okay, question two. This one will be a little harder.
en: Okay, question two. This one will be a little harder.
ja: じゃあ第二問。ちょっと難しくなるわよ。

key: Assuming you can see them all from one angle or another, how many satellite dishes are there in the Obsidia Ward?
en: Assuming you can see them all from one angle or another, how many satellite dishes are there in the Obsidia Ward?
ja: どこかの角度から全部見えると仮定して、オブシディアワードにあるパラボラアンテナは何基?

key: DANIELLE: Hmph.
en: DANIELLE: Hmph.
ja: ダニエール: ふん。

key: Yes, that's right. But that's obvious.
en: Yes, that's right. But that's obvious.
ja: そう、正解よ。でもそんなの当然よね。

key: Fine. Since you've done well this far, oh mighty questionee, I'll give you a really good one!
en: Fine. Since you've done well this far, oh mighty questionee, I'll give you a really good one!
ja: いいわ。ここまでよくやったわね、偉大なる回答者様。とっておきの一問をあげる!

key: Ready?
en: Ready?
ja: 準備はいい?

key: How many banners and ribbons are there inside the Peridot Gym?
en: How many banners and ribbons are there inside the Peridot Gym?
ja: ペリドットジムの中にある旗とリボンは合わせて何個?

key: DANIELLE: Tch.
en: DANIELLE: Tch.
ja: ダニエール: ちっ。

key: Fine. That's correct.
en: Fine. That's correct.
ja: いいわ。正解よ。

key: I'm so impressed and overcome with wonder at how you could have possibly known the answer.
en: I'm so impressed and overcome with wonder at how you could have possibly known the answer.
ja: どうやって答えを知ったのか、感心と驚きでいっぱいだわ。

key: Wowie.
en: Wowie.
ja: はぁー、すごいすごい。

key: But I'll keep my promise and give you the reward, if that's really what you want.
en: But I'll keep my promise and give you the reward, if that's really what you want.
ja: でも約束は守るわ。本当にそれが欲しいなら、ご褒美をあげる。

key: ...Impressive.
en: ...Impressive.
ja: ……大したものね。

key: Most normal people don't get that right.
en: Most normal people don't get that right.
ja: 普通の人は、そう簡単に正解できないのに。

key: You already knew these answers somehow, didn't you?
en: You already knew these answers somehow, didn't you?
ja: どうせ答えを最初から知ってたんでしょ?

key: Well, whatever.
en: Well, whatever.
ja: まあ、いいけど。

key: I'll keep my promise and give you a reward.
en: I'll keep my promise and give you a reward.
ja: 約束通り、ご褒美をあげるわ。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 03!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 03!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書03を手に入れた!

key: Info on Misty Terrain now available!
en: Info on Misty Terrain now available!
ja: ミストフィールドの情報が閲覧できるようになった!

key: DANIELLE: But hey?
en: DANIELLE: But hey?
ja: ダニエール: でもね?

key: I've been all over Reborn, and I effortlessly pick up this kind of information.
en: I've been all over Reborn, and I effortlessly pick up this kind of information.
ja: わたしはリボーン中を歩き回ってきたから、こういう情報は苦もなく入ってくるの。

key: You seem like you've gotten around a fair bit, but I bet I know things about lots of other places you'd never even think of!
en: You seem like you've gotten around a fair bit, but I bet I know things about lots of other places you'd never even think of!
ja: あなたもそこそこ色々な場所を回ってきたみたいだけど、あなたが思いもしないような場所のことも、わたしはきっと知ってるわよ!

key: So if you wanna try this again, I'm game.
en: So if you wanna try this again, I'm game.
ja: だから、また挑戦したいなら付き合うわ。

key: Come back after you've traveled as much as I have, and we'll try this again!
en: Come back after you've traveled as much as I have, and we'll try this again!
ja: わたしと同じくらい旅をしてから、また挑戦しに来なさい!

key: DANIELLE: There!
en: DANIELLE: There!
ja: ダニエール: そこ!

key: Just because you're normal, it doesn't mean you know more than me!
en: Just because you're normal, it doesn't mean you know more than me!
ja: 普通の目が見えるからって、わたしより物知りとは限らないのよ!

key: DANIELLE: Wrong!
en: DANIELLE: Wrong!
ja: ダニエール: 不正解!

key: Surely you couldn't miss something as big as a satellite dish, could you?
en: Surely you couldn't miss something as big as a satellite dish, could you?
ja: パラボラアンテナみたいに大きいもの、見逃すはずないわよね?

key: Or are you the blind one?
en: Or are you the blind one?
ja: それとも、目が見えないのはあなたの方?

key: DANIELLE: Hmm~ Wrong!
en: DANIELLE: Hmm~ Wrong!
ja: ダニエール: んー、不正解!

key: What's the matter? Didn't you pass by there once or twice?
en: What's the matter? Didn't you pass by there once or twice?
ja: どうしたの? そこ、一度や二度は通ったんじゃないの?

key: Did the trees hide from your perfect eyes' sight?
en: Did the trees hide from your perfect eyes' sight?
ja: その完璧な目から、木たちが隠れちゃったのかしら?

key: How disappointing.
en: How disappointing.
ja: 実に嘆かわしいことだ。

key: DANIELLE: Awh. That's no fun.
en: DANIELLE: Awh. That's no fun.
ja: ダニエール: あら。つまらないわね。

key: If a girl can't even pick on people who assume they're better than her, what's she got to live for?
en: If a girl can't even pick on people who assume they're better than her, what's she got to live for?
ja: 自分より優れてると思い込んでる人をからかうことすらできないなら、女の子に生きてる意味なんてある?

key: DANIELLE: Come back after you've traveled as much as I have, and we'll try this again!
en: DANIELLE: Come back after you've traveled as much as I have, and we'll try this again!
ja: ダニエール: わたしと同じくらい旅をしてから、また挑戦しに来なさい!

key: DANIELLE: Yawn.
en: DANIELLE: Yawn.
ja: ダニエール: ふあぁ。

key: Did you find all your answers yet?
en: Did you find all your answers yet?
ja: 答え、もう全部見つけた?

key: DANIELLE: Are we really going to do this again?
en: DANIELLE: Are we really going to do this again?
ja: ダニエール: 本当にまたやるの?

key: Does it bring you a sense of fulfillment knowing you just go specifically looking for the answers instead of learning to observe as you go?
en: Does it bring you a sense of fulfillment knowing you just go specifically looking for the answers instead of learning to observe as you go?
ja: 観察して学ぶんじゃなくて、わざわざ答えを探しに行くだけで満足感なんて得られるの?

key: There's no point if you do that, but if it really means that much to you, I'll gratify you once more.
en: There's no point if you do that, but if it really means that much to you, I'll gratify you once more.
ja: それじゃ意味がないけど、それでもそんなに望むなら、もう一度付き合ってあげる。

key: Don't say I'm not nice.
en: Don't say I'm not nice.
ja: わたしが優しくないなんて言わせないわよ。

key: Are you ready, oh master surveyor?
en: Are you ready, oh master surveyor?
ja: 準備はいい、偉大なる観察者様?

key: DANIELLE: Oh, back so soon?
en: DANIELLE: Oh, back so soon?
ja: ダニエール: あら、もう戻ってきたの?

key: Did you actually learn anything?
en: Did you actually learn anything?
ja: ちゃんと何か学んだの?

key: DANIELLE: We'll see about that.
en: DANIELLE: We'll see about that.
ja: ダニエール: それはどうかしらね。

key: Grand rematch of the century, battle of the ages and all that: Question one!
en: Grand rematch of the century, battle of the ages and all that: Question one!
ja: 世紀の再戦、時代を超えた戦い、とかなんとか――第一問!

key: How many individual train cars are there in the Byxbysion Wasteland?
en: How many individual train cars are there in the Byxbysion Wasteland?
ja: ビクスビジョン荒地にある列車の車両は全部で何両?

key: DANIELLE: Yeah, yeah, okay. So you can count, big deal.
en: DANIELLE: Yeah, yeah, okay. So you can count, big deal.
ja: ダニエール: はいはい、わかったわ。数を数えられるのね、大したもんだこと。

key: For the record, the only reason I'm even doing these 'how many' questions still is for the sake of tradition.
en: For the record, the only reason I'm even doing these 'how many' questions still is for the sake of tradition.
ja: 念のため言っておくけど、こういう『いくつ』系の問題を続けてるのは、単なる伝統みたいなものよ。

key: And I wouldn't want to overwhelm you.
en: And I wouldn't want to overwhelm you.
ja: それに、あなたを圧倒したくもないしね。

key: Question two: How many buildings total are in Ametrine City?
en: Question two: How many buildings total are in Ametrine City?
ja: 第二問――アメトリンシティ全体にある建物は何棟?

key: DANIELLE: Glad that those didn't escape your keen sight.
en: DANIELLE: Glad that those didn't escape your keen sight.
ja: ダニエール: あなたの鋭い目から逃げられなかったみたいで何より。

key: Question three!
en: Question three!
ja: 第三問!

key: There's a man who lives in the Aventurine Woods with a bunch of Pikachu.
en: There's a man who lives in the Aventurine Woods with a bunch of Pikachu.
ja: アベンチュリンの森には、大量のピカチュウと一緒に暮らしている男がいるの。

key: How many Pikachu are usually inside his house?
en: How many Pikachu are usually inside his house?
ja: 普段、彼の家の中にいるピカチュウは何匹?

key: DANIELLE: I'll give you points for that one; it's harder to keep track when they're all running around.
en: DANIELLE: I'll give you points for that one; it's harder to keep track when they're all running around.
ja: ダニエール: それはポイントをあげるわ。走り回ってると数えにくいものね。

key: But this isn't over yet!
en: But this isn't over yet!
ja: でも、まだ終わりじゃないわよ!

key: How many satellite dishes are there in all of Spinel Town?
en: How many satellite dishes are there in all of Spinel Town?
ja: スピネルタウン全体にあるパラボラアンテナは何基?

key: DANIELLE: That's right!
en: DANIELLE: That's right!
ja: ダニエール: 正解!

key: Trick question! You got me.
en: Trick question! You got me.
ja: ひっかけ問題だったの! やられたわね。

key: Okay, okay. A real one this time!
en: Okay, okay. A real one this time!
ja: はいはい。今度は本物の問題よ!

key: How many bookshelves are there in all of Apophyll Academy?
en: How many bookshelves are there in all of Apophyll Academy?
ja: アポフィルアカデミー全体にある本棚は何個?

key: DANIELLE: All right! You're doing well!
en: DANIELLE: All right! You're doing well!
ja: ダニエール: よし! 良い調子じゃない!

key: Too well, in fact, so I'm going to throw everything I've got at you!
en: Too well, in fact, so I'm going to throw everything I've got at you!
ja: むしろ良すぎるわ。だから、持ってるもの全部ぶつけてやる!

key: Final question! This is for all the cookies!
en: Final question! This is for all the cookies!
ja: 最終問題! 全部かけての勝負よ!

key: How many trees are there in all of Chrysolia Forest?!
en: How many trees are there in all of Chrysolia Forest?!
ja: クリソリアの森全体にある木は何本!?

key: DANIELLE: ...
en: DANIELLE: ...
ja: ダニエール: ……

key: Just kidding!
en: Just kidding!
ja: なんてね!

key: Even I don't know that one.
en: Even I don't know that one.
ja: それはさすがのわたしも知らないわ。

key: But I'll let you have it.
en: But I'll let you have it.
ja: でも、正解にしてあげる。

key: Even if you did just go specifically look for the answers, think about what I said about learning to observe and not just see.
en: Even if you did just go specifically look for the answers, think about what I said about learning to observe and not just see.
ja: たとえ答えをわざわざ調べただけだとしても、ただ見るんじゃなく観察するっていうさっきの話を、ちゃんと考えてみて。

key: You're pretty good.
en: You're pretty good.
ja: あなた、なかなかやるじゃない。

key: Too good, really.
en: Too good, really.
ja: 本当に、良すぎるくらいに。

key: Did you already know what I was going to ask?
en: Did you already know what I was going to ask?
ja: わたしが何を聞くか、最初から知ってたの?

key: Regardless, that ended up being kind of fun.
en: Regardless, that ended up being kind of fun.
ja: まあいいわ、結局それなりに楽しかったし。

key: So in return for letting me tease you, you can have this.
en: So in return for letting me tease you, you can have this.
ja: からかわせてくれたお礼に、これをあげる。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 31!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 31!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書31を手に入れた!

key: Info on Fairy Tale Field now available!
en: Info on Fairy Tale Field now available!
ja: フェアリーテイルフィールドの情報が閲覧できるようになった!

key: DANIELLE: I'd like to travel the world someday.
en: DANIELLE: I'd like to travel the world someday.
ja: ダニエール: いつか世界中を旅してみたいわ。

key: People always talk about seeing it, but they never mention how each place has different sounds, scents and atmospheres.
en: People always talk about seeing it, but they never mention how each place has different sounds, scents and atmospheres.
ja: みんな「見る」ことばかり話すけど、場所ごとに違う音や匂い、雰囲気のことなんて誰も言わないのよね。

key: That's what I live on.
en: That's what I live on.
ja: それがわたしの糧なの。

key: When that happens, and I finally go visit everywhere, I'll be sure to get more questions to pick on you with!
en: When that happens, and I finally go visit everywhere, I'll be sure to get more questions to pick on you with!
ja: それがかなって、全部の場所を回れたら、あなたをからかうための問題をもっと増やしてあげるから!

key: DANIELLE: Realllllly?
en: DANIELLE: Realllllly?
ja: ダニエール: ほんとーに?

key: Are you really really realllllly sure?
en: Are you really really realllllly sure?
ja: ほーんとに、ほんとに、確かなの?

key: I think you should check again!
en: I think you should check again!
ja: もう一回確かめた方がいいと思うわ!

key: After all, that seems to be the only way you'll do things.
en: After all, that seems to be the only way you'll do things.
ja: 結局、あなたはそうやってしか物事をやらないみたいだし。

key: DANIELLE: Pi-pi, pikachuuuu!
en: DANIELLE: Pi-pi, pikachuuuu!
ja: ダニエール: ピィピィ、ピカチューウ!

key: By the way, that's Pikachu-eese for "You're wrong and also a loser."
en: By the way, that's Pikachu-eese for "You're wrong and also a loser."
ja: ちなみに今のはピカチュウ語で「あなたは間違ってる、それに負け犬」って意味よ。

key: DANIELLE: Ahaha...
en: DANIELLE: Ahaha...
ja: ダニエール: あはは……

key: No.
en: No.
ja: 違うわ。

key: You really didn't learn anything, did you? You can't even remember buildings? Did you not notice them?
en: You really didn't learn anything, did you? You can't even remember buildings? Did you not notice them?
ja: 本当に何も学ばなかったのね? 建物すら覚えてないなんて。気づかなかったの?

key: DANIELLE: Out on the first try!
en: DANIELLE: Out on the first try!
ja: ダニエール: 一発アウトね!

key: Come on, it's not like those trains are going anywhere. How do you miss them?
en: Come on, it's not like those trains are going anywhere. How do you miss them?
ja: ちょっと、あの列車がどこかに行くわけでもないのに、どうして見逃すのよ?

key: I can practically see them all just by walking around in that place.
en: I can practically see them all just by walking around in that place.
ja: わたしなんて、あの辺りを歩いてるだけでほとんど見えてるくらいなのに。

key: DANIELLE: At least you're honest. I can respect that.
en: DANIELLE: At least you're honest. I can respect that.
ja: ダニエール: 正直なのは認めてあげる。それは尊重するわ。

key: I'll be waiting!
en: I'll be waiting!
ja: 待ってるから!

key: DANIELLE: When I can finally travel the world, I'll be sure to get more questions to pick on you with!
en: DANIELLE: When I can finally travel the world, I'll be sure to get more questions to pick on you with!
ja: ダニエール: やっと世界を旅できるようになったら、あなたをからかう問題をもっと増やしてあげるから!

key: DANIELLE: Pardon me?
en: DANIELLE: Pardon me?
ja: ダニエール: 何ですって?

key: Oh, pardon me?
en: Oh, pardon me?
ja: あら、何ですって?

key: You're asking if I can read braille?
en: You're asking if I can read braille?
ja: 点字が読めるかって聞いてるの?

key: Just because I'm blind?
en: Just because I'm blind?
ja: わたしが盲目だからって?

key: Don't you think that's stereotyping a bit too much?
en: Don't you think that's stereotyping a bit too much?
ja: それって、ちょっと決めつけが過ぎると思わない?

key: Do you think all blind people are just born knowing braille?
en: Do you think all blind people are just born knowing braille?
ja: 盲目の人はみんな生まれつき点字を知ってるとでも思ってるの?

key: Do you think something like that is easy to learn?
en: Do you think something like that is easy to learn?
ja: そういうものが簡単に習得できるとでも?

key: Just pick up a book and translate a few sentences to solve a puzzle in a video game or something?
en: Just pick up a book and translate a few sentences to solve a puzzle in a video game or something?
ja: 本を手に取って、ゲームのパズルを解くみたいに二、三文を訳せば済むとでも思ってるの?

key: Well, you're right.
en: Well, you're right.
ja: まあ、その通りだけど。

key: It is easy, and of course I know braille-- I'm not a troglodyte.
en: It is easy, and of course I know braille-- I'm not a troglodyte.
ja: 簡単だし、点字くらいもちろん知ってるわ――わたしは原始人じゃないもの。

key: Tell me what you need, and be frank about it.
en: Tell me what you need, and be frank about it.
ja: 何が必要か、率直に言いなさい。

key: Mm.
en: Mm.
ja: うーん。

key: Braille tablets in a newly formed dimension?
en: Braille tablets in a newly formed dimension?
ja: 新しくできた次元に、点字の石板?

key: This sounds like a reasonable and believable story.
en: This sounds like a reasonable and believable story.
ja: それはずいぶん筋の通った、信じられる話ね。

key: And what makes you think that this neo-dimensional braille of yours, assuming I choose to believe you, even translates to a known spoken language?
en: And what makes you think that this neo-dimensional braille of yours, assuming I choose to believe you, even translates to a known spoken language?
ja: それに、仮にあなたを信じるとして、その新次元の点字とやらが既知の言語に対応してるなんて、どうして言えるの?

key: You didn't think about that, did you?
en: You didn't think about that, did you?
ja: そんなこと、考えてもみなかったんでしょ?

key: Right.
en: Right.
ja: そうだね。

key: Well, let's go see your allegedly newly-spawned braille blocks ourselves, shall we?
en: Well, let's go see your allegedly newly-spawned braille blocks ourselves, shall we?
ja: じゃあ、その新しく現れたっていう点字ブロックとやらを、自分の目で確かめに行きましょうか。

key: I use the term "see" loosely, of course.
en: I use the term "see" loosely, of course.
ja: もちろん、「目で」っていうのはあくまで比喩だけど。

key: So tell me the way and I'll go there myself.
en: So tell me the way and I'll go there myself.
ja: だから道順を教えて。自分で行くわ。

key: I detest hand-holding.
en: I detest hand-holding.
ja: 手を引かれるのは大嫌いなの。

key: In fact, I'm sure I'll beat you there.
en: In fact, I'm sure I'll beat you there.
ja: むしろ、あなたより先に着く自信があるわ。

key: Ta.
en: Ta.
ja: じゃあね。

key: Welcome! Only residents are allowed upstairs, but please feel free to visit in the lobby!
en: Welcome! Only residents are allowed upstairs, but please feel free to visit in the lobby!
ja: いらっしゃいませ! 上の階は住人専用ですが、ロビーへのご来店はご自由にどうぞ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
